newsitem.title: FINLAND: NESTE TRADING & SUPPLY UNIT HEAD TO QUIT.
newsitem.headline: NESTE TRADING & SUPPLY UNIT HEAD TO QUIT.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said in a statement on Monday Eija Malmivirta, head of its international trading & supply division, had decided to leave the company.
Under a new group oil business structure which took effect in April, Malmivirta was responsible for sales and manufacturing coordination, wholesale and supply.
Neste announced on July 26 it had incurred crude oil trading losses, especially in the months of June and July. Total tradig losses anticipated for the full year were 285 million markka.
On August 16, the company said chief financial officer Veli-Matti Ropponen had been appointed executive director in charge of its oil division and deputy chief operating officer.
Neste did not say in Monday's statement why Malmivirta had decided to leave, but said she would still be available for the board to consult on issues related to the Middle East and Russia.
Neste said Risto Riekko had been appointed as Ropponen's deputy following Malmivirta's resignation.
A Neste spokeswoman said Malmivirta's resignation was with immediate effect.
